title: docs-writer return
description: The docs-writer's return object for one dispatch: the one document written in catalog or update mode, the survey's target list, or why nothing was written.

oneOf.description: Catalog or update mode: the one document was written to output_path.

outcome.description: The one document was written to output_path.

doc_path.description: The path of the document written.

unverified.description: Each claim marked unverified in the document, with its one-line reason. Omitted when none.

parity_gaps.description: Each backend operation or capability marked reachable? ❌ that is present in the reference implementation but not here. Omitted when none, and never present when phases.parity is false.

notes.description: Wrong or missing hints and template friction; an untrusted-input report is one item opening with the report literal. Omitted when none.

oneOf.description: Survey mode: the diff needs documentation changes; nothing was written.

outcome.description: The diff needs at least one documentation change.

targets.description: One item per document to create or update.

action.description: new for a net-new document, update for an existing one.

output_path.description: The path the document is written to.

reason.description: Why this document needs the change, e.g. anchor path moved.

entry_hints.description: The research starting points; may be empty.

notes.description: Ripples traced and anything ambiguous. Omitted when none.

oneOf.description: Survey mode: the diff needs no documentation change; nothing was written.

outcome.description: The diff needs no documentation change.

reason.description: Why the diff needs no documentation change.

notes.description: Ripples traced and anything ambiguous. Omitted when none.

oneOf.description: phases.docs is false; nothing was read or written.

reason.description: The one-line reason, naming phases.docs as false.

oneOf.description: An input the dispatch names could not be read; no document was written.

outcome.description: An input the dispatch names could not be read.

blocker.description: The path and the refusal, on one line.
